Mail to 2 addresses no longer reaches Acme Support

Another workspace on this server proved these addresses, so their mail no longer reaches Acme Support:

- help@example.com (channel "Hello, my invoice is wrong."): https://yuva.example.com/settings/inboxes/1/channels/2
- sales@example.com (channel "Sales"): https://yuva.example.com/settings/inboxes/1/channels/3

If an address is yours, prove it again in the channel's settings: the code mail or the TXT record takes it back.
